operations.details: Verified Environment Agency persistent DTM1m WCS endpoint and WCS 2.0.1 service contract from current DSP guidance.
Current DSP guidance states WCS provides raw pixel data such as elevation rather than rendered map-only values.
Current DSP guidance documents WCS GeoTIFF NoData as approximately -3.4028235e+38; current sampler fail-closes values below -1e30.
Current EA DTM1m metadata describes the composite as produced in 2022 from surveys spanning 6 June 2000 through 2 April 2022.
EA metadata states repeat surveys use the newest best-resolution data available to the 2022 composite and resampling used bilinear interpolation where required.
EA DTM1m metadata retains +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy and EPSG:27700 CRS.
Locked distinction: a current persistent WCS endpoint does not imply that every served elevation pixel was observed in 2026.
Locked distinction: preserved 96% result confidence is workflow/evidence confidence, not a statistical confidence interval or temporal-freshness probability.
Read hash-backed canonical lidar_catalogue_lineage_runtime_036.json for exact target-point survey lineage evidence.
Row30762 composite catalogue returns overlapping 1m DTM lineage candidates with survey dates in 2018 and 2020; catalogue alone does not prove which source supplied every exact WCS pixel.
Row30762 numeric 0.270m is preserved without claiming a 2026 observation epoch.
Row46142 composite 1m DTM lineage record is survey period 22 Dec 2018 to 8 Jan 2019, comp_year 2022.
Row46142 numeric 0.831m is preserved without claiming a 2026 observation epoch.
Row61522 composite 1m DTM lineage record is dated 7 Feb 2018, comp_year 2022.
Row61522 numeric 0.490m is preserved without claiming a 2026 observation epoch.
EA Time Stamped Tiles metadata confirms archived DTM survey dates, resolution, transform and geoid can vary by survey and should be read from catalogue lineage.
EA Time Stamped Tiles metadata confirms elevations are in metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and aligned to the OS Grid.
EA metadata states transformation used is specific to survey time period; legacy time-stamped transform labels are not silently treated as current OSTN15 metadata.
Canonical sampler uses WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities, validates pinned CoverageId, reads DescribeCoverage axis labels and requests GeoTIFF in EPSG:27700.
Canonical sampler validates TIFF content and excludes extreme negative NoData values before statistics.
Canonical EA sampler uses all_touched=False so height statistics use valid raster pixel centres inside the exact HMLR polygon.
Canonical sampler records capabilities, DescribeCoverage and each GeoTIFF SHA-256 for runtime provenance.
No new EA WCS request/CRS/NoData program block found in the pinned sampler during this static/current-source audit.
Closed QA semantic gap by requiring service-current and observation-epoch labels to remain separate in web/support evidence.
Preserved numeric results remain 0.270m, 0.831m and 0.490m at 96% evidence confidence; no temporal freshness uplift applied.
Three Terrain50 numeric samples and three EA-to-OS numeric crosschecks remain pending; epoch QA does not substitute for current Terrain50 bytes.
Existing F-host guarded recovery remains the sole canonical business root blocker; no second runner/task created.
Publisher-safe child staging only; no canonical manifest mutation, business promotion, force push, fake data or final_ready claim.
